articles.summary: Companies make well-intentioned pledges to their customers all the time. Certainly, these are not empty promises, but they are often too broad to be meaningful. When someone is promised an “exceptional experience” what does that really mean? Or is that just a buzz word?
articles.title: The Veris Promise: Our Commitment to You

articles.summary: As a part of the Veris Promise, we have made sure all of our residents have the option to bring a furry friend into their life. No more restrictions on dog breeds, plenty of amenities to take care of their needs, and making an overall welcoming space for felines and canines alike. There are plenty of ethical breeders ready to give a family their perfect pet, and an overabundance of animals in shelters all around the country; fur babies all equally deserving of a loving life.
articles.title: Pet-Friendly Living: How Veris Residential Welcomes Pets of All Shapes and Sizes

articles.summary: When you choose Veris Residential, you gain more than an apartment—you join a thriving community designed to enhance every aspect of your life. Each Veris community is equipped with a wide suite of comfortable spaces, activities, gyms, rest areas and more! From our hydroponic gardens to our work-from-home spaces, we offer all kinds of services and amenities to make sure your life with us is safe, smooth and healthy.
